name: Souls of Chronos Gaiden
detailed_description:
Join two girls on a tortuous journey of revenge and face their fates.

Explore a world full of dangers

Experience the main story of "Souls of Chronos Gaiden", explore this hand-crafted 2D world, where different ideas collide with each other, and see Kolya grow during the journey.

Build your own fighting style

Through exploration, collect different combat skills and magic, continuously strengthen them, combine them at will, customize your own fighting style, and defeat powerful enemies with Shi Ling.

Strengthen yourself and your time spirit partners

Achieve additional conditions, obtain new skill disks, unlock enhancements, and perform reliable combined attacks with Shi Ling in battle.

Meet different partners

As the story progresses, you will get to know teammates with different personalities, experience different fighting methods, and spend the days and nights of this wonderful journey with them.

Game features:

·Free combination of combat skills

·Use the "Heart Chain" to configure magic and customize your own fighting style

·2D hand-painted romantic world

·As the story progresses, you can get to know teammates with different personalities and unlock different combat systems.

short_description: Souls of Chronos Gaiden is a 2D action-adventure game. Play the role of the sword-wielding girl 'Kolia' and the her partner 'Mika' to embark on an unusual journey of revenge. Strengthen your character, defeat powerful enemies, and witness the flash of light at the end of the journey.
